title: Increased-Order Generalized Synchronization in Memristive Neurons: Analytical and Data-Driven Approaches
summary: We investigate increased-order generalized synchronization between four- and five-dimensional memristive Hindmarsh--Rose neurons, focusing on the selection and stabilization of the synchronization map. An analytical construction combines a prescribed nonlinear map with adaptive control, retaining the memristive switching contribution explicitly in the error dynamics. Lyapunov analysis establishes asymptotic synchronization under uniform strict dissipativity and yields a switching-independent decrease estimate outside an explicit error neighborhood.
